note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Prepare statements run in one PowerShell session with the episode folder as current directory; variables do not survive into the screens, so each screen re-derives what it needs.
prepare: # owner, once: Docker Desktop (WSL 2 engine) is installed and running; this episode uses the Windows docker CLI on C:\work (same commands as in WSL)
# the SA password is generated here and lives only in C:\work\secrets\demo.env (never printed, never in the repo)

if (-not (Test-Path C:\work\secrets\demo.env)) { $k = 'MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD'; $pw = 'Aa1!' + (-join ((48..57 + 65..90 + 97..122) | Get-Random -Count 16 | ForEach-Object { [char]$_ })); Set-Content C:\work\secrets\demo.env "${k}=$pw" }

screens.name: buildrun
commands: # change one line of Program.cs, nothing else
Add-Content src\Contoso.Orders.Api\Program.cs "// rebuilt for the demo"
screens.note: Expect the restore step CACHED and the publish step re-run. Windows docker CLI, curl.exe because curl is an alias in Windows PowerShell 5.

screens.name: stack
commands: # the SA password goes into .env (copied from a file outside the repo, never shown)
screens.note: First `docker compose up -d` must fail naming MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD (no .env yet). Never run docker compose config or open .env on camera. Extra capture for the edit: Docker Desktop > Containers with the contoso-orders group expanded (api, db).

screens.name: watch
screens.app: VS Code + Windows Terminal (docker compose watch)
steps: Open C:\work\ep04\orders-app in VS Code: Program.cs (src/Contoso.Orders.Api) on the left, integrated terminal on the right
In the terminal run: docker compose watch
Add a field to the /healthz object, e.g. version = "watch-demo", and save
Capture the terminal while Compose rebuilds the api service and recreates its container
In a second terminal run: curl.exe -s localhost:8080/healthz   and show the new field
Run: docker compose exec api sh   and capture the real error text (the chiseled image has no shell)
Revert the Program.cs edit (git checkout -- src/Contoso.Orders.Api/Program.cs) and stop docker compose watch with Ctrl+C
mask: WSL / Windows user name in paths and prompts
Docker Desktop and VS Code account avatars
never show .env or docker compose config

teardown: docker rm -f orders 2>$null; docker volume rm orders-data 2>$null
blocked: Docker Desktop is not installed on the recording laptop (and its licence terms for Momento Galatico must be confirmed); the whole episode needs a Docker daemon.
